models_evaluated: externally developed deep learning PET tumour segmentation model

links.outcome: Performance of externally developed segmentation model on local retrospective PET/CT data for stratifying loco-regional control
links.effect: Higher AI-derived ΔPET-GTV stratified loco-regional control (log-rank p = 0.02); 2-year control 94.1% vs 53.6%; clinician found AI volumes acceptable in 78% of cases.
links.quote: Patients with higher ΔPET-GTV (i.e. greater tumour shrinkage) had significantly improved loco-regional control (log-rank p = 0.02).

screen.reason: The study conducts an external clinical validation of a deep learning PET/CT segmentation model for delta biomarker prognostic stratification and includes clinician qualitative review, but it does not compare outcomes of or directly test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
